Frequently Asked Questions

When was Juan Marichal born?

Juan Marichal was born on October 20, 1937.

Where was Juan Marichal born?

Juan Marichal was born in Laguna Verde, Dominican Republic.

How tall is Juan Marichal?

Juan Marichal is 6-0 (183 cm) tall.

How much did Juan Marichal weigh when playing?

Juan Marichal weighed 185 lbs (83 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Juan Marichal play?

Juan Marichal played 16 seasons.

Is Juan Marichal in the Hall of Fame?

Juan Marichal was elected into the Hall of Fame in 1983.

What position did Juan Marichal play?

Juan Marichal was a Pitcher.

How many strikeouts did Juan Marichal have?

Juan Marichal had 2,303 strikeouts over his career.

How many teams has Juan Marichal played for?

Juan Marichal played for 3 teams; the Boston Red Sox, Los Angeles Dodgers and San Francisco Giants.

How many World Series has Juan Marichal won?

Juan Marichal has never won a World Series.

When did Juan Marichal retire?

Juan Marichal last played in 1975.

What are Juan Marichal's nicknames?

Manito,Dominican Dandy,Mar are nicknames for Juan Marichal.
